description: Verkehrszahlen Velo Kanton St.Gallen is a dataset listed in St.Gallen open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Tiefbauamt Kanton St.Gallen, Mobilität und Planung, Verkehrstechnik. Verkehrszahlen des Veloverkehrs auf den Kantonsstrassen. Die Zahlen werden durch permanente Verkehrszählstellen erhoben. Die Zuständigkeit liegt bei der Verkehrstechnik im Tiefbauamt des Kanton St.Gallen. Coverage: Canton of St. Gallen. The portal files it under Mobility and Transport. Its keywords are verkehr, Zählstelle, velo. The portal shows 78 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-daten-sg-ch-portal.
